common_error_patterns.description: Incorrect version specified for quarkus-artemis-jms extension
common_error_patterns.resolution: Corrected to use Quarkus BOM-managed version
common_error_patterns.prevention: Always prefer BOM-managed versions for Quarkus extensions - omit <version> tag

common_error_patterns.description: audit-logging-library-1.0.0.jar configured with system scope and hardcoded path
common_error_patterns.resolution: Installed JAR to local Maven repository and updated dependency configuration
common_error_patterns.prevention: Avoid system-scoped dependencies - use proper Maven repository deployment
When using reactive messaging annotations, ensure SmallRye Reactive Messaging extension is included alongside Artemis JMS if both are needed

for_similar_migrations: Start with dependency and configuration setup - a solid foundation prevents cascading issues
Perform namespace migration (javax to jakarta) systematically across all files
Migrate simple EJB components before complex ones - builds confidence and reveals patterns
Use Quarkus BOM-managed versions for all Quarkus extensions - omit explicit version tags
Convert remote EJB lookups to CDI injection - plan these carefully as they're architectural changes
Consolidate configuration to application.properties early - provides clarity for all subsequent steps
Consider deferring test migration to separate iteration if it doesn't block core functionality
Delete vendor-specific stubs/shims only after replacement functionality is verified

summary.overall_assessment: The migration from Java EE 7 on JBoss EAP to Quarkus 3 was highly successful. 98% of planned steps completed (53/54), build passed, and only 3 fix iterations were needed across 9 phases. The questionnaire decisions proved to be excellent choices - particularly the CDI conversion strategy, configuration consolidation, and lifecycle event migration.

Successful EJB to CDI conversion for all service components
Complex remote EJB removal replaced with CDI injection
Configuration consolidated from multiple XML/JSON files to single application.properties
Message-Driven Beans successfully migrated to Quarkus Artemis JMS
Zero compilation errors in final build

Complex JNDI lookups replaced with CDI injection
